name: Beloperone
source:
“Eheheh, Florentine, you’re really sharp.
I like that.”

Unit: Offense Black, 1st Squad
Rank: Baggage

A girl who serves as a vanguard soldier in the Ruined World.

She has an unusual sense of style and often speaks with a sharp, cynical tone.

She may come across as malicious, but she also has a cautious and devoted side. Her sensitivity to others' feelings allows her to assess situations accurately.

Class: Dreamer
Reality-Altering Ability: Violet Miasma — an ability that produces a corrosive mist that breaks down anything it touches. It can be expanded, concentrated or otherwise adjusted according to the situation.
